name: Command Injection
Description: An exploit where an attacker successfully injects malicious command payloads into the communication stream, executing unauthorized system-level operations or flight controller commands.
Symptoms: Unexpected flight state changes (e.g., in-flight motor disarm commands)
Unrecognized command codes or malformed parameters in flight controller inputs
Suspicious background processes running on the companion computer, or sudden CPU spikes
Impact: Total compromise of drone operation, including potential flight termination, payload theft or drop, camera feed interception, or crashing the drone.
Recommended Action: Reject all unauthenticated command packets. Immediately transition the flight controller to a secure Safe Mode. Isolate companion computer network processes and notify the operations team.
